events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: The iconic Oasis frontman, Liam Gallagher, celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Liam's Birthday
angles.copy: Still rock 'n' roll, still got the attitude. Happy 54th to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis or solo track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' (1975 re-release)
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic single 'Imagine' was re-released in the UK in 1975, reaching a new generation of listeners.

angles.name: Imagine Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since the notable 1975 re-release of John Lennon's timeless anthem, 'Imagine'. A message that still resonates today.

events.title: First Apple iPod turns 25
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the original iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising how we carry our music.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember a quarter-century ago when Apple put '1,000 songs in your pocket'? The original iPod turns 25. What was the first song you loaded on yours?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day celebrates the premiere of the first 007 film, Dr. No, which debuted on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Bond Day
angles.copy: Grab a martini, shaken not stirred. It's Global James Bond Day, marking 64 years since Dr. No first hit the big screen. Who's your favourite Bond?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the legendary John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true master of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, famously known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered their sprawling, iconic 'White Album'. Which track from the double LP is your absolute favourite?

events.title: 35 years since Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the world lost the incomparable Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, on November 24, 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Tribute
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago today, we lost a true legend. Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury, whose voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years of 'Rubber Soul'! The Beatles' pivotal album changed the game in '65. What's your go-to track from this masterpiece?

events.title: 46 years since John Lennon's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of music icon John Lennon on December 8, 1980.

angles.name: Lennon Death Anniversary
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, 46 years on from his passing. His legacy of peace, love, and incredible music lives on.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary David Bowie, who would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Bowie Tribute
angles.copy: On what would have been his 80th birthday, we honour the extraordinary life and music of David Bowie. A true chameleon of rock, always pushing boundaries.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Remembering the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Elvis Tribute
angles.copy: The King would have been 92 today. Celebrating the enduring legacy of Elvis Presley, whose music continues to shake, rattle, and roll the world.
